verdict.rationale: Skyfire describes its tokens as conforming to the 'open KYAPay protocol, an industry specification' and markets itself as 'accepted by the majority of the commercial internet.' The pack, however, names no independent party that implements KYAPay or the platform. Card-network partnerships and approval-gated sellers in Skyfire's own directory are integrations with Skyfire, not independent implementations, and charging, wallets and settlement all run through Skyfire's own APIs. So there is no evidence of two or more third-party implementers.
